CustomField.label: Approver 4
CustomField.description:
★R9 Level 4 of the approval chain. Unused at the shipped configuration and deliberately so.
requirement.md caps the chain at two levels above the Account Owner, so levels 4 and 5 stay blank and their approval steps are skipped. They exist because "more levels later" was stated as a requirement up front: raising Approval_Chain_Setting__mdt.Max_Levels_Above_Account_Owner__c to 3 or 4 starts populating them with no deploy and no code change. Only a chain longer than five levels costs metadata.
